summary: Douglas County, OR: 20-foot pole L-4 lookout on the Umpqua National Forest, dated 1928-1933 by sources and removed in 1962 or 1963; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1962 or 1963; no source describes what remains at the site

Panorama photos taken by Lester Moe and Robert Cooper, August 6, 1933

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the L-4 tower to 1933; the Forest Lookouts history gives a pole tower around 1928 and an L-4 house on a tower in 1932. The sources do not reconcile these, so the story reports all three.
The register says removed in 1963, firelookout.com says destroyed in 1963, and Forest Lookouts gives 1962 for the removal. The sources differ on the year and on how the tower ended.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on build year (c.1928, 1932, 1933) and removal (1962 or 1963; removed vs destroyed). The brief's point 43.28116, -122.22768 matches the register's coordinates (N 43.281160, W 122.227680). The brief's other point, 43.30123, -122.23643 (west_us_lookouts), is not from any source we read and was not checked. No source describes the site today; the register's 2007 site photo was not viewed. Access status unknown; no source found.
